newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN says sells reinsurer for 700 mln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: GAN says sells reinsurer for 700 mln Ffr.

text.p: French insurer GAN said on Friday it had signed an agreement to sell its reinsurance unit Cie Transcontinentale de Reassurance (CTR) to the Canadian company Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd for 700 million francs.
Gan said the disposal was part of a strategy to refocus on core activities as part of its recovery plan.

For Fairfax, which specialises in non-life insurance in the United States and Canada, "this purchase offers an opportunity to get a significant foothold in the reinsurance market in Europe," GAN said.
CTR had turnover of 1.8 billion francs.

GAN said the transaction would allow CTR to pursue its development with a new shareholder that has already signalled its desire to grow in the reinsurance market with its acquisition of Skandia American Re in the United States at the start of the year.
